title: Claim
description: A single, atomic, falsifiable assertion made within an investigation. Claims are the testable units of an investigation. Each claim must be either supported, contested, refuted, or unresolved by the available evidence.

investigation_id.description: The investigation this claim belongs to.

statement.description: The claim stated precisely and falsifiably. Must be a single atomic assertion. Must be in past tense for historical events.

claim_status.description: The current evidential status of the claim, distinct from lifecycle status.

evidence_ids.description: IDs of Evidence entities that bear on this claim.

assessment_ids.description: IDs of Assessment entities evaluating this claim.

related_claim_ids.description: IDs of related or contradictory claims within the same or other investigations.

context.description: Background context necessary to understand the claim. Does not constitute evidence.
